title: Rafael and the Hollow
author: Wren Amberdale
blurb: Hazel Underhill, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
